item.title: Police seek public’s help locating three teens missing from Timothy Hill Ranch
item.description: Riverhead Town police are asking for the public’s help locating three juveniles reported missing from the Timothy Hill Ranch after leaving the facility on foot Feb. 18, police said.

item.title: Riverhead Ukrainian parish invites community to memorial services marking four years since Russia’s full-scale invasion
item.description: Riverhead’s Ukrainian Catholic church will mark the fourth anniversary of Russia’s invasion with Stations of the Cross and a memorial service.

item.title: Gerard Nightingale, 82
item.description: Gerard Nightingale “Jerry,” of Riverhead, died Feb. 18, 2026, at East End Hospice Inc. He was 82 years old.

item.title: Latino advocates urge Riverhead to adopt local law addressing public safety during ICE activity
item.description: OLA urged Riverhead to consider a public safety law tied to ICE activity the organization is asking all East End towns and villages to adopt.

item.title: Heavy snow, blizzard conditions possible Sunday into Monday
item.description: A winter storm watch is in effect for Suffolk County from Sunday morning through Monday afternoon, with blizzard conditions possible, according to the National Weather Service.

item.title: A $33 billion nuclear bailout is coming to your electric bill
item.description: New Yorkers will pay $33 billion from 2029–2049 to keep four aging upstate nuclear plants operating, under a new PSC approval. Column by Karl Grossman

item.title: Riverhead’s Old Time Jam Band’s music is ‘upbeat, happy’ — and contagious
item.description: The Old Time Jam Band keeps Appalachian dance tunes alive with an upbeat, welcoming jam circle twice a month at Riverhead library.

item.title: Updated blizzard warning for Long Island: 15-20″ of snow, gusts up to 60 mph expected
item.description: A blizzard warning is in effect for Long Island and the New York City metro area from 1 p.m. Sunday through 6 p.m. Monday.

item.title: Winter storm emergency in effect in Riverhead as starting 9 p.m. Saturday; on-street parking banned
item.description: A winter storm emergency has been declared in Riverhead as of 9 p.m. Saturday, for a major storm expected to bring heavy snow and strong winds to the area Sunday and Monday.

item.title: Jessica Zablocky Altieri, 35
item.description: Jessica Zablocky Altieri died Feb. 18, 2026. She was 35 years old.
